firm_data.firm_description: Reid Collins & Tsai LLP is a boutique trial firm that practices complex litigation nationally and internationally. They represent trustees, liquidators, foreign governments, international banks, individuals, and companies from the U.S. and abroad in federal and state courts across the country.
notable_facts: The firm offers flexible and sensible fee arrangements.
Their trial attorneys include a team of former federal prosecutors, judicial law clerks, and forensic accountants.
Lisa S. Tsai became Managing Partner of the firm on September 23, 2021.

email.subject: AI for Reid Collins & Tsai LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Roman,

Complex commercial litigation across multiple jurisdictions demands precision without the overhead of BigLaw. Reid Collins & Tsai handles exactly that work, and I imagine managing financials across 43 attorneys handling financial fraud, cross-border disputes, and Ponzi scheme cases creates real operational challenges.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Austin to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
